scope: Public Google authorization-start regression repair for the current personal schedule site.

repair.observed_defect: A browser-identity fallback could return to the same sign-in page without starting Google authorization.
repair.new_behavior: The fallback posts to Better Auth social sign-in, validates the Google authorization host, then navigates to the returned authorization URL.

not_proven: A completed Google account selection and callback on Version 127.
A completed email registration, verification, reset, and sign-in replay on Version 127.
Current Version 127 A/B tenant isolation or physical second-device history readback.
